starter_files.contents:
# Resilient Data Collection Service

## Objective
Collect and transform data from authorized APIs and report failures consistently.

## Safety
Use synthetic datasets, disposable local fixtures, or explicitly authorized lab resources. Do not store secrets in this repository.

## Deliverables
- Source code and configuration
- A documented expected output
- Tests or a repeatable human-review checklist
- Version/platform assumptions and troubleshooting notes

stretch_features: Add Pester tests for normal, empty, invalid and expected-failure cases.
Add PSScriptAnalyzer checks and document supported PowerShell editions.
Make repeated runs idempotent where practical and include a preview/report mode.

tests.name: Functional behavior
criteria: Required features work on representative synthetic inputs.
Expected outputs and failure behavior are documented.

tests.name: Reliability and security
criteria: Invalid values, missing dependencies and expected external failures are handled.
No real secrets, personal data or unauthorized targets are included.

tests.name: Reproducibility
criteria: Another learner can reproduce the review using the instructions.
Supported PowerShell versions and OS assumptions are stated.

rubric.criterion: Input validation, failure handling and security

review_method: Human-reviewed project rubric; static text checks do not prove functional correctness or security.
status_note: Draft project adapted from Section D of PowerShell.pdf; complete and review implementation details before publication.
